year6Ordering.ownerRule: The final browser-visible Year 6 list must be chronological by visible display code.
year6Ordering.lessons: Y6TnMm sorts by term n then lesson m.

historicalProvenFix.mechanism: Standalone script explicitly loaded by index.html, visible lesson-code DOM sorting, MutationObserver reapplication, and explicit cache-busting.

currentV2Port.rule: The ordering fix lives only in the standalone last-mile guard. The V2 application source remains the exact tested/deployed 2026-10-02 source.

preservation.rule: Future browser deployments must rebuild from this branch or a descendant, verify src/app.js still matches the preserved 2026-10-02 base unless an independently authorised frontend change exists, preserve the standalone ordering guard, and deploy through fpt-portal-v2-rebuild-browser-prod ASSETS.

baseFrontend.rule: src/app.js is byte-for-byte the exact frontend source used by the successful 2026-10-02 live Browser Worker asset deployment. Do not modify it for the Year 6 ordering fix.

liveTopology.note: GitHub Pages is not the live serving path while the Cloudflare Worker route is active. Production frontend changes must deploy Browser Worker assets.

pagesFallback.role: fallback/mirror only while the Cloudflare Browser Worker route is active
